decisions.executionNote: Begin left-arm approach toward front green bottle, gently bending from origin and turning inward; right arm stays home.
Continue diagonal open-gripper approach to the green bottle while preserving the current elbow branch.
Align left fingertips around green bottle body; approach remains open and slow near contact.
Green bottle tilted on contact; adjust toward its body, close and make a short lift to inspect retention.
Green is not retained and now lies on right side. Reopen left and approach pink; prepare right arm for overhead green pickup without crossing.
Align left approach straight toward pink body while lowering; raise and pitch right wrist over fallen green bottle.
Close left around aligned pink bottle and test a short lift; position right wrist vertically above green.
Pink appears retained; lift and carry leftward. Rotate right overhead jaws across green bottle's long axis.
Continue slow left carry while monitoring pink retention. Finish cross-axis right jaw alignment and lower slightly toward green.
Pink slipped and lies on table; reopen and prepare top-down regrasp. Lower right jaws around green with small vertical increments.
Close right jaws and test green retention with a small lift. Continue left overhead alignment toward fallen pink.
Green is moving with right gripper; lift clear and hold. Finish left top-down orientation above pink for a body grasp.
Replan after continuity rejection with smaller left orientation increments, descending over pink body. Right holds green stationary.
Close left fingers around pink body and test retention with a small lift. Right maintains green grasp.
Test pink retention while lifting and withdrawing toward bin. Keep both grips closed; right holds green clear.
Pink was not retained; return over its body with open left jaws, correcting the previously too-high grasp. Right keeps green secure.
Lower left gripper to pink body height rather than closing above it; close at the end and inspect. Right remains still holding green.
Settle closed left grasp, then lift pink slowly to verify retention before carrying over bin; right holds green.
Pink visibly lifted with left gripper; carry toward bin with clearance and closed grip. Right remains holding green.
Move retained pink fully inside bin opening before releasing; keep right gripper closed on green.
Release pink over bin and withdraw left. Present green near midline with right, maintaining closed grip for handover.
Pink is visible inside bin. Move open left gripper toward green's free end for handover; right presents bottle without crossing midline.
Advance left toward the free green-bottle base, remaining on left side. Right holds the bottle steady for transfer.
Bring open left jaws alongside green's free base for a two-hand grasp, leaving right grip fixed.
Wrist bodies are contacting during handover. Back left outward and tilt its fingers inward to reach the free bottle end with greater wrist separation.
Align angled left fingers around green's base and close while the right continues holding, before releasing the donor grip.
Left fingers appear short of the green base. Reopen and advance slightly farther around the free end, with right holding steady.
Keep left closed around free end, open right donor and separate slowly to verify handover retention.
Withdraw left with green after handover, lifting and carrying toward bin. Move open right toward remaining lying white bottle.
Carry securely retained green left toward bin, turning it to fit. Approach lying white bottle from above with open right jaws.
Green slipped from end grasp; reopen and approach its body from above on left table. Lower right jaws around lying white bottle.
Center left above green body for firmer regrasp. Right encountered bottle contact; lift and recenter jaws toward far side before descending again.
Lower left around green body and close. Recenter right jaws over the displaced white bottle while descending slowly, correcting wrist tilt.
Lift green with the firmer body grasp. Finish right descent, close around white bottle and make a small retention test.
Lift both bottles with grips closed; carry green toward bin and move right-held white clear of table for handover.
Carry green farther over bin with closed body grasp. Bring right-held white forward into a clear handover area.
Position all of green within bin opening before release; move white toward central handover while retaining it.
Release green fully over bin, withdraw left open, and present white's neck across the midline while keeping right arm on its own side.
Two bottles visible in bin. Bring left toward white's free neck, tilting fingers inward so wrists stay separated during handover.
Advance angled left fingers to white bottle's neck with donor stationary and closed; avoid bringing wrist bodies together.
Seat left jaws around the white bottle cap/neck and close before releasing the right donor grip.
Open donor right hand, separate slowly and test whether left retains white by its neck before carrying.
Separate arms further to verify white-bottle handover; left carries slowly without rotating and right retracts open.
White is retained by left after handover. Carry slowly toward bin, turning gradually; right approaches above the last standing bottle.
Continue slow left carry and rotation to fit white inside bin. Right advances toward standing bottle with slightly lower wrist to preserve reach margin.
Bring white fully over bin before opening. Right slowly aligns over the last bottle's upper body while lowering to reduce reach.
White slipped near table edge; reopen left and prepare body regrasp. Right retracts from reach limit and tilts inward for a less extended approach.
Use much smaller right retraction and tilt after continuity rejection; left prepares overhead regrasp of slipped white.
Align left jaws across fallen white body near bin edge. Approach last standing bottle from its right with an inward-tilted wrist and open jaws.
Lower and close left on white body for secure regrasp. Last bottle has tipped; reorient right jaws for overhead pickup while reducing reach.
Close left around white body and test lift. Replan right after IK rejection by retreating toward its workspace before further rotation.
Previous chunk executed nothing. Use sub-millimeter right retreat near the joint limit; close left and make a small white-bottle lift.
Lift retained white toward bin with a firm body grasp. Reorient right jaws across the last fallen bottle while retreating slightly from the reach limit.
Move white away from bin rim then release. Reconfigure right to a forward-angled lower approach, avoiding the shoulder reach limit.
Withdraw open left after bin release. Finish forward-angled right approach with jaws across last white bottle's body.
Correct rejected tensor; close right on last bottle and make a short retention-test lift. Move open left toward receiving area.
Lift and withdraw last bottle in right hand to confirm retention and prepare handover; orient open left fingers inward.
Present right-held last bottle toward left workspace while keeping right wrist on its side; ready open left receiver with inward-angled fingers.
Continue rotating right-held bottle toward the open left receiver, using small increments and keeping donor wrist to the right.
Left fingers are below the bottle neck; raise and flatten receiver approach while backing wrist away, donor stays closed and still.
Close aligned left jaws on the free upper body of last bottle while right continues holding, allowing the grasp to settle.
Left closed above rather than around bottle. Reopen and lower jaws to the free upper body while donor remains fixed.
Close left around the now-centered bottle neck and settle the two-hand grasp; donor remains closed until retention is visually checked.
Receiver still appears above and behind bottle. Reopen, lower and shift toward the free neck; right continues supporting it.
Close left around corrected neck depth and settle both hands before attempting donor release.
Receiver fingers still close short of the bottle. Reopen, advance and lower around the upper body while donor supports it.
Settle receiver grasp then open donor and make a very small separation to check handover retention.
Handover did not retain bottle. Clear right hand and raise/reorient open left for a secure overhead body grasp after it settles.
Approach the settled last bottle from above-left with jaws across its axis. Retract open right arm toward home without crossing.
Lower left around last bottle's body on the left side of midline. Finish retracting the right arm toward origin.
Seat left fingers slightly deeper around last bottle, close and test a small lift; right settles at origin.
Lift last bottle clear with left body grasp and start gentle binward carry without rotating; right remains home.
Last bottle visibly follows left gripper; continue level carry toward bin with closed grip and fixed orientation.
Continue carrying the last bottle leftward at constant height and orientation; retain grip until the entire bottle clears the bin rim.
